extraction_scope.overclaim_guard: Mechanism is kept as cellular phenotype/mechanism-support context; no direct molecular binding target is asserted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: WRK is source-supported as a membrane-active cytotoxic peptide in Jurkat cells, with membrane permeabilization and Raman chemical imaging showing loss/disorganization of cellular compartments after treatment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: WRK / Warnericin RK on Jurkat leukemia cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper proposes a membranolytic mode from cellular imaging/permeabilization; it does not identify a direct molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: WarnG20D and WarnF14V are source-supported as lower-hemolysis WRK analogs that retain anti-leukemia activity and induce less drastic Jurkat cell deformation/leakage phenotypes than WRK.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: WarnG20D and WarnF14V on Jurkat leukemia cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level images support qualitative deformation/leakage context; exact image-derived quantitative values were not fabricated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The local source supports a selectivity caution: MNC cells had no numeric LD50 in Table 1 and Raman imaging/narrative report no comparable cell-damage effect at tested peptide exposure.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: WRK analog selectivity toward MNC healthy cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: MNC exact LD50 is not reported; preserved as ND rather than converted to a numeric threshold.
